description: The credits a SnowStorm game rewards (reward.credits.winner.range 7-7, loser.range 3-3), handed out on the next 1 s game tick after GAMEEND; otherwise snowstorm-game: a game end to end on arena 4 (two teams): STARTGAME (GAMELOCATION, the tickets, the started game to an observer), entering the arena (ROOM_DIRECTORY -1, the map's HEIGHTMAP, FULLGAMESTATUS and OBJECTS_WORLD on G_HMAP), SNOWSTORM_GAMESTATUS every 300 ms, no events before GAMESTART, walking (GAMEEVENT 0), a long throw at a player and its hit, a quick throw that hits, a short throw at a tile, making a snowball (GAMEEVENT 3), REQUESTFULLGAMESTATUS, three instant hits (trajectory 3) that stun, no throwing while stunned, GAMEEND with the scores, the finished game for the observer, back to the lobby and the points
